race.comment: MISS AUSTRALIANA (7) is a smart mare racing in good form, putting two wins together at this circuit and distance. A wider starting position poses more of a challenge this time but she is going well enough to overcome that and land the hat trick. ERROL FIN (6) led and faded when tackling a higher-graded race at his latest appearance. Good effort when runner-up here two back and should be race fit fourth-up. Draws wider but is good enough to take out a race like this. PELIGROSO (1) didn't do a bad job when fourth from the widest barrier last time out and is well served by the ace draw. MAYWYNS MIGHTY MAC (3) draws well and can be competitive coming back in grade.
